paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn
model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two different models across varying turns. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Turn ID," which are displayed as even numbers in ascending numerical order from 0 to 26. The vertical axis represents the measured value, labeled "Avg. JGA Score," featuring a linear scale that ranges from a minimum of 0.2 to a maximum of 1, with tick marks and corresponding light gray horizontal grid lines spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The data is organized into groups for each Turn ID, with each group containing two side-by-side bars. As indicated by the legend located in the upper right quadrant, the orange bars represent the "LLaMA-7B" model and the yellow bars represent the "T5-small" model. Both sets of bars exhibit a general, though not strictly monotonic, decreasing trend in height as the Turn ID progresses from left to right. The tallest bars for both models appear at Turn ID 0, where LLaMA-7B reaches a value of approximately 0.96 and T5-small reaches roughly 0.95. Conversely, the shortest bars are found at higher Turn IDs; the lowest value for LLaMA-7B occurs at Turn ID 26 at approximately 0.44, while the lowest value for T5-small is located at Turn ID 24 at roughly 0.30. No individual bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines beyond their standard solid color assignments.
